social:piasnews-social-2894837dc48c7af4:.source_text: Q: can turn this picture back around next year? OP: using the off season to have a reset is going to be useful. i don't think these problems are going to solve themselves without putting a lot of effort into it, there's going to be a lot of hard work. https://t.co/ZpGuyK4hX6
social:piasnews-social-2894837dc48c7af4:.zh: 问：明年能把局面扭转回来吗？OP：利用休赛期进行重置会很有用。我不认为这些问题不投入大量努力就能自行解决，会有很多艰苦的工作。

social:piasnews-social-17a269a51aae1f64:.source_text: Q: why did last year unravel at the end? OP: a number of reasons. there was a couple of places where i struggled for pace. as a team we also would do some things differently if we did it again. the impact of some of those things was big sometimes. https://t.co/oZb1fS7Fpt
social:piasnews-social-17a269a51aae1f64:.zh: 问：为什么去年年底崩盘了？OP：有很多原因。有几个地方我在速度上很挣扎。作为车队，如果再来一次，我们也会做一些不同的事情。其中一些事情的影响有时很大。

social:piasnews-social-ff15b973d8dd52cb:.source_text: oscar on whether the struggles this year are the same, or related to, the struggles last year: "i wouldn't say so. some of the specific things from last year are maybe the same, but the general picture is quite different." https://t.co/EpFQOIPoqs
social:piasnews-social-ff15b973d8dd52cb:.zh: Oscar谈今年的挣扎是否与去年的挣扎相同或相关：“我不这么认为。去年的一些具体问题也许是一样的，但整体情况相当不同。”

social:piasnews-social-97acae86960e1208:.source_text: "the 1st half of the year was about understanding what i needed to change. it was difficult because some weekends were good & some bad; trying to understand why they were so different wasnt straightforward. the 2nd half has been actually trying to fix it." https://t.co/e6sfBritgs
social:piasnews-social-97acae86960e1208:.zh: “上半年是了解我需要改变什么。这很困难，因为有些周末很好，有些很糟；试图理解为什么它们如此不同并不简单。下半年实际上是在尝试解决它。”

social:piasnews-social-09ea086a942bcd46:.source_text: "a lot of the things that worked well for me in previous cars don't work this year, and a lot of things that you wanted to stay away from in previous cars are what you want to exploit this year. that rewiring has taken some getting used to." https://t.co/9X2lnyRnr9
social:piasnews-social-09ea086a942bcd46:.zh: “以前赛车上对我很有效的很多东西今年不管用了，而以前赛车上你想避开的很多东西今年反而是你想利用的。这种重新布线需要一些适应。”

social:piasnews-social-c1d09429e600447e:.source_text: Q: how much does racing more consciously impact your performance? OP: you ask any athlete when they're performing at their best: when you're not thinking about what you're doing, when you're in a state of flow. i havent been in a state of flow this year. https://t.co/I2PFFETsSn
social:piasnews-social-c1d09429e600447e:.zh: 问：更有意识地比赛对你的表现有多大影响？OP：你问任何运动员他们最佳状态时：当你不去想自己在做什么，当你处于心流状态。我今年还没有进入过心流状态。

social:piasnews-social-d7943b5e49804c51:.source_text: Q: Could you just touch on the fight with lando, you didn't appreciate that particular instruction... "😅😅. Yeah! Yeah, I mean we know what we're doing! We don't need to be told. I think for the team that was a great result we obviously got a little close at some points but I think we're both very clear with what the goal was, which was to score as many points for the team as possible. We definitely didn't race too hard. I think we raced each other very smart and ensured we both stayed up the front."
social:piasnews-social-d7943b5e49804c51:.zh: 问：能谈谈和 Lando 的争夺吗，你似乎不太喜欢那条指令……“😅😅。是啊！是啊，我是说我们知道自己在干什么！不需要别人来告诉我们。我觉得对车队来说那是个很棒的结果，我们显然在某些时刻靠得有点近，但我认为我们俩都很清楚目标是什么，就是为车队尽可能多拿分。我们绝对没有拼得太凶。我觉得我们互相竞争得非常聪明，也确保了我们俩都留在前面。”

social:piasnews-social-af804cec70983ef2:.source_text: Q: How were you able to get that result today? "Um..I don't know 😅. it was a bizarre race. Obviously a massive pack with the slipstream being so important. I think our pace generally was pretty good, we're obviously lacking a bit on the straights but I think we're making up for it in the corners. It was just a bit odd in terms of overtaking and where you would overtake, like it wasn't normal. Is the only way I could put it. There was a bit of strategy involved with the buttons used and where to use your energy, where to save it and stuff like that so I think we did a pretty good job on that."
social:piasnews-social-af804cec70983ef2:.zh: 问：你今天是怎么拿到这个成绩的？“呃……我也不知道 😅。这是一场很诡异的比赛。显然是一大集团，尾流太重要了。我觉得我们的整体节奏相当不错，直道上确实有点吃亏，但我认为我们在弯道里补回来了。超车方面就是有点奇怪，在哪儿超车，感觉不太正常。我只能这么说。还涉及一些策略，比如按钮怎么用、在哪里用能量、在哪里省能量之类的，我觉得我们这方面做得相当不错。”
